threat_event: Attacker uses a Constructors commissioning kit to issue unauthorized gate commands at a rehabilitation site
threat_source: Criminal or nation-state actor using a compromised contractor laptop or router
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Kit connected to the DEV-05 gate control network for 41 days with a remote support tool and a default router password
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-H3 at DEV-05 and other rehabilitation sites
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a access control; Form 3 Q12); C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-003-9 Att. 1 Sec. 6); C-DAMS-R02 (12.3(b)(4)(ii))
existing_controls: Interim rule from 2026-07-16; DEV-05 kit removed and imaged
treatment_plan: Permanent commissioning design (group plan GR-01); gate position alarms routed to the HOC during rehabilitation work

threat_event: Vendor remote access is misused through an Intermediate System session
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 26 vendors with on-demand sessions; MFA and recording in place
existing_controls: MFA; per-session approval; session recording; SOC alerts
treatment_plan: Monthly review of vendor session recordings by the OT security team

threat_event: Ransomware reaches plant DMZs through the two-way DSMS replication
threat_source: Ransomware group that first compromised the DSMS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two-way replication at 17 plants
existing_controls: Port-limited firewall rules
treatment_plan: One-way transfer at 17 plants (group plan GR-03)

threat_event: Attackers exploit unpatched vulnerabilities in unsupported plant HMIs and gate control workstations
threat_source: Criminal or nation-state actor already inside the OT network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 58 plant HMIs and 11 gate control workstations run an unsupported operating system
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-007-6 R2 Part 2.3 mitigation plans); C-DAMS-R01 (Form 3 Q15)
existing_controls: Mitigation plans per CIP-007-6 Part 2.3; host firewalls; no internet access
treatment_plan: Replace gate workstations first (2027-03), then HMIs (2027-12); allow-listing on remaining hosts

threat_event: A HOC-A outage lasts longer than the 2-hour RTO because the failover is slow
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2026-06-13 failover took 2.6 hours; manual ICCP restart
existing_controls: HOC-B; plants can run in local control
treatment_plan: Automate the ICCP failover; repeat the failover test by 2027-03-31

threat_event: An intrusion at a plant without OT monitoring goes undetected for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 27 of 41 HOC-operated plants without OT sensors
existing_controls: Firewall logs reviewed weekly; process alarms at the HOC
treatment_plan: Sensors at all 41 plants by 2027-06-30, Group 1 and 2 dams first

threat_event: Recovery after a compromise takes days because PLC logic backups are stale
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Logic backups at 12 plants more than 12 months old; 4 governor configurations never backed up
existing_controls: Nightly SCADA backups; offline copies at HOCs
treatment_plan: Backup after every change and quarterly for all PLCs; restore test of one plant per quarter

threat_event: Malware is introduced to plant control systems on removable media
threat_source: Contractor or technician carrying infected media
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 11 plants without scanning kiosks; contractors bring their own media
existing_controls: Kiosks at HOCs and 30 plants; port blocking on HOC consoles
treatment_plan: Kiosks at the 11 remaining plants; media rule in the Constructors supplement

threat_event: SERC finds a potential noncompliance with CIP-003-9 Attachment 1 Sections 5 and 6 at BES plants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Commissioning kits not handled as Transient Cyber Assets or vendor remote access at 3 BES plants
affected_asset_or_process: Low impact BES plants with rehabilitation projects
existing_controls: Interim rule; self-report filed 2026-09-30
treatment_plan: Mitigation plan with SERC; evidence of the new commissioning design

threat_event: Dam safety instrument data is manipulated to hide a developing problem
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Gauge links use cellular modems; data acquisition shares the plant network at some sites
existing_controls: Private cellular network for gauges; manual readings
treatment_plan: Cross-check automated readings with manual readings monthly at Critical dams

threat_event: Intruders reach a gate house or HOC control room
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote sites; patrols at Group 1 dams; cameras at Group 1 and 2 dams
existing_controls: PACS at HOCs; locks, cameras, and alarms at dams
treatment_plan: Gate house intrusion alarms at the remaining 9 Group 2 dams

threat_event: An ICCP link to a Balancing Authority is lost or tampered with
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Encrypted ICCP links on leased circuits
existing_controls: Encryption; alternate path through the other HOC
treatment_plan: Annual test of link recovery with each Balancing Authority

threat_event: A malicious update from the governor and excitation OEM is installed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 55% of units serviced by one OEM; integrity verification relies on vendor hashes
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-010-4 R1 Part 1.6; CIP-013-2 R1 Part 1.2.5)
existing_controls: Software integrity check before install
treatment_plan: Group plan GR-08

threat_event: 11 plants lose OT WAN service because they depend on one leased circuit
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No diverse path at 11 plants
existing_controls: Local control; radio
treatment_plan: Licensed microwave backup at the 11 plants

threat_event: An operator misuses gate controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Operators need gate command rights
existing_controls: PRAs; command logging; supervisor review
treatment_plan: Group plan GR-09

threat_event: Phishing compromises HOC staff corporate accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: HOC staff use corporate email; OT accounts are separate
existing_controls: MFA; separate OT identity domain
treatment_plan: Quarterly phishing exercises include HOC staff

threat_event: Section 9 plans and schedules slip, and FERC questions the certification letters
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many negative Form 3 answers at plants below the HOC
existing_controls: Letters reviewed by the Director, Hydro Security and the NERC Compliance Director
treatment_plan: Track the plan and schedule items in the POA&M; two-person review of each letter

threat_event: A construction project changes gate PLC logic outside Hydro change control and leaves an unsafe condition
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rehabilitation projects use Constructors change records; Hydro does not review gate logic changes at 2 sites
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Table 9.3a secure design); C-DAMS-R02 (12.11(b)(2) modification reporting)
existing_controls: Factory and site acceptance tests
treatment_plan: Hydro change board approves all logic changes at Hydro sites; Hydro witness at commissioning

threat_event: BCSI or security-sensitive documents leak through engineering or construction shares
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Network diagrams shared with Constructors and Engineering project teams
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R03 (CIP-011-3 R1; CIP-004-7 R6); C-DAMS-R01 (Sec. 3.2 OPSEC)
existing_controls: Restricted BCSI library; access reviews every 15 months
treatment_plan: Find and remove BCSI outside the library; NDA for affiliate project teams

threat_event: A cyber event at a plant is not recognized as a reportable condition, so FERC, NERC, and EAP steps start late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant staff unfamiliar with 12.3(b)(4)(xi) and CIP-003 Section 4 determinations
existing_controls: CIP-008 plan; EAP cross-references
treatment_plan: Plant-level quick cards; training for plant managers; P08 runbook

threat_event: A flood coincides with loss of remote gate control and crews cannot reach local panels in time
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote dams; flood tolerance about 1 hour
existing_controls: Pre-staging crews when floods are forecast; annual local control drills
treatment_plan: Pre-staging rule in the EAP operating procedures for all 32 HOC-operated gated dams

threat_event: Default credentials on field devices let an attacker change gate panel or gauge settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: DEV-05 commissioning router default password; 6 plant HMIs with generic accounts
existing_controls: Commissioning checklist includes password change
treatment_plan: Credential sweep of all field devices; generic accounts removed or controlled

threat_event: Wireless gauge links are spoofed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Private cellular network; device certificates on newer gauges only
existing_controls: Private network
treatment_plan: Certificates on remaining gauges at replacement

threat_event: Scheduling platform compromise sends wrong schedules to Balancing Authorities
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cloud-hosted platform with role-based access
existing_controls: MFA; validation before release
treatment_plan: Annual penetration test of the platform

threat_event: Ransomware on plant administrative networks halts maintenance work orders
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plant administrative networks on the corporate WAN
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Sec. 9.4: business network separated from operations)
existing_controls: EDR; segmentation from OT
treatment_plan: Group plan GR-02

threat_event: Missed seepage or piezometer anomaly at one of the 31 dams moved to monthly manual readings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reliance on AI-001 alerts
existing_controls: Rules-based thresholds; annual Part 12D inspections
treatment_plan: Return to weekly manual readings (group plan GR-05)

threat_event: The recreation reservation vendor is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor-hosted payment page; contact data only
existing_controls: Vendor SOC 2 report; no card data stored
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Hydro security and compliance lead

threat_event: The OT security team cannot keep up with 41 plants plus 7 rehabilitation projects
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 OT security engineers; plant rollouts and CIP evidence compete
existing_controls: Prioritization by Section 9 criticality
treatment_plan: Add 6 OT security engineers in the 2027 budget

threat_event: A Blackstart Resource fails to start because of a control system fault
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Blackstart tests annually
existing_controls: Annual blackstart tests with the Transmission Operators
treatment_plan: Configuration baseline checks before each test

threat_event: GPS time is spoofed and corrupts event times used in investigations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: GPS clocks at HOCs and plants
existing_controls: Clock monitoring at HOCs
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Hydro security and compliance lead
